snippet.title: Satarichi: Heroes De Caelum
snippet.description: Join the fight for Caelum in this co-op action RPG for up to 4 players. Control legendary heroes in real-time combat as you explore an epic world based on the original novel by Satarichi. Enjoy the adventure with friends locally or via Remote Play Together!
